capabilities: Add prayer requests and record answers
Track daily thanksgiving with a goal and streak
Log evangelism contacts by date, name and method
Follow the 365-day McCheyne Bible reading plan
Open Bible passages in the Bible Translation Compare plugin
extras: Korean-only interface; source is viewable but not open-source; free for personal, church and non-profit use; no network requests or AI.
problem: Believers have no single private place in Obsidian to track prayer, gratitude, evangelism contacts and daily Bible reading without sending data to outside services.

relations.evidence: If the Bible Translation Compare plugin is enabled, tapping a passage opens it there.

summary: Plain-Markdown notebook for prayer requests, daily thanksgiving, evangelism contacts and a 365-day McCheyne Bible reading plan.
